description: Repo-only review of how this devkit's skills and agents fit together after a skill is added, renamed, split, or substantially changed: runs the mechanical checks, then reads for routing gaps, conflicting advice, duplicated rules, and missing two-way pointers between related skills. Use when the user asks to review cross-references, check skill wiring, or make sure everything still fits after a skill change. Not shipped with the plugin.
